unit_cn: Unit 2 Let's Celebrate! 让我们庆祝
source: 外研社版(新标准)必修第二册 Unit 2 词表(p113-115 真词);IPA 标准词典英音回填;例句原创、节日/庆祝主题、含目标词、不超纲;多义词给多个中文释义。

words.example_en: Families gather to celebrate the festival every year.
words.example_cn: 每年家家户户都团聚庆祝这个节日。

words.example_en: The Lantern Festival celebrations attract crowds of people.
words.example_cn: 元宵节庆祝活动吸引了大批人群。

words.example_en: The Spring Festival is the most important festival in China.
words.example_cn: 春节是中国最重要的节日。

words.example_en: Eating dumplings is a tradition many families keep.
words.example_cn: 吃饺子是许多家庭保留的传统。

words.example_en: We decorate our windows with red posters before the festival.
words.example_cn: 节前我们用红色海报装饰窗户。

words.example_en: The streets were full of colourful decorations for the New Year.
words.example_cn: 为庆祝新年,街道上挂满了五彩的装饰物。

words.example_en: Children carry bright red lanterns through the streets.
words.example_cn: 孩子们提着明亮的红灯笼走过街道。

words.example_en: At midnight, fireworks lit up the whole sky.
words.example_cn: 午夜时分,烟花照亮了整个天空。

words.example_en: People love to guess the riddles written on the lanterns.
words.example_cn: 人们喜欢猜写在灯笼上的谜语。

words.example_en: Our school held a lantern riddle competition for the festival.
words.example_cn: 我们学校为这个节日举办了灯谜比赛。

words.example_en: Rice balls are a popular dessert during the Lantern Festival.
words.example_cn: 汤圆是元宵节里很受欢迎的甜点。

words.example_en: The lantern fair attracts thousands of visitors each year.
words.example_cn: 灯会每年吸引数千名游客。

words.example_en: The host welcomed every guest at the door.
words.example_cn: 主人在门口迎接每一位客人。

words.example_en: The host prepared a big meal for all the guests.
words.example_cn: 主人为所有客人准备了一顿大餐。

words.example_en: A wedding usually needs a formal written invitation.
words.example_cn: 婚礼通常需要正式的书面邀请。

words.example_en: We wear our best clothes on such a special occasion.
words.example_cn: 在这样特别的场合,我们会穿上最好的衣服。

words.example_en: The festival occurs on the fifteenth day of the first lunar month.
words.example_cn: 这个节日在农历正月十五举行。

words.example_en: The date of the festival follows the lunar calendar.
words.example_cn: 这个节日的日期按农历计算。

words.example_en: The Mid-Autumn Festival celebrates the autumn harvest.
words.example_cn: 中秋节庆祝秋天的丰收。

words.example_en: A colourful dragon dance opened the festival.
words.example_cn: 一场多彩的舞龙表演拉开了节日的序幕。

words.example_en: The Dragon Boat Festival honours an ancient poet.
words.example_cn: 端午节是为了纪念一位古代诗人。

words.example_en: People read his poetry aloud to remember him.
words.example_cn: 人们大声朗读他的诗歌来纪念他。

words.example_en: The festival is held to honour a famous poet.
words.example_cn: 举办这个节日是为了纪念一位著名的诗人。

words.example_en: Tolkien is a famous name in English literature.
words.example_cn: 托尔金是英国文学中的一个著名人物。

words.example_en: He is best known for his fantasy novels.
words.example_cn: 他以奇幻小说而闻名。

words.example_en: His books created a rich world of fantasy for readers.
words.example_cn: 他的书为读者创造了一个丰富的奇幻世界。

words.example_en: Inside the envelope was a handwritten letter.
words.example_cn: 信封里是一封手写的信。

words.example_en: Polar Bear was a regular character in the letters.
words.example_cn: 北极熊是这些信中的常客。

words.example_en: In one letter, Father Christmas complained about his helpers.
words.example_cn: 在一封信里,圣诞老人抱怨他的助手。

words.example_en: The letters did not contain the usual warning to children.
words.example_cn: 这些信里没有给孩子们通常的那种告诫。

words.example_en: The bold words indicate how sure the speaker is.
words.example_cn: 黑体字表明了说话人有多么确定。

words.example_en: She sent a polite request asking him to the party.
words.example_cn: 她发出礼貌的请求,邀请他参加聚会。

words.example_en: Everyone came to the fancy dress party in costume.
words.example_cn: 每个人都穿着戏服来参加化装舞会。

words.example_en: That guy dressed as Batman is my classmate.
words.example_cn: 那个打扮成蝙蝠侠的男生是我同学。

words.example_en: The two guys in costume waved at us happily.
words.example_cn: 那两个穿着戏服的男生高兴地向我们挥手。

words.example_en: Students from many schools participate in the celebrations.
words.example_cn: 许多学校的学生都参加这些庆祝活动。

words.example_en: He wrote a letter to the editor about the festival.
words.example_cn: 他就这个节日给主编写了一封信。

words.example_en: I have to admit that cooking the dinner is hard work.
words.example_cn: 我得承认做这顿饭很辛苦。

words.example_en: Preparing the festival meal takes a lot of effort.
words.example_cn: 准备节日大餐要花很多力气。

words.example_en: Eating out has nothing to do with the loss of traditions.
words.example_cn: 在外面吃饭与传统的丧失毫无关系。

words.example_en: On Spring Festival Eve the whole family eats together.
words.example_cn: 除夕之夜,全家人一起吃饭。

words.example_en: I loved listening to the adults chatting about their year.
words.example_cn: 我喜欢听大人们聊他们这一年的事。

words.example_en: To me, the process of cooking together matters most.
words.example_cn: 对我来说,一起做饭的过程最重要。

words.example_en: The retired teacher shared his memory of the festival.
words.example_cn: 这位退休教师分享了他对节日的回忆。

words.example_en: Many old festival customs still exist today.
words.example_cn: 许多古老的节日习俗至今仍然存在。

words.example_en: Chinese people living overseas also celebrate the festival.
words.example_cn: 生活在海外的华人也庆祝这个节日。

words.example_en: The Spring Festival is becoming a global celebration of joy.
words.example_cn: 春节正成为一场全球性的欢乐庆典。

words.example_en: People of many nationalities now enjoy the festival.
words.example_cn: 如今许多国籍的人都喜欢这个节日。

words.example_en: The concert drew a large audience of local people.
words.example_cn: 音乐会吸引了大量当地观众。

words.example_en: The festival fills the streets with joy and laughter.
words.example_cn: 节日让街道充满欢乐与笑声。
